title: A Wasserstein lower bound for local group-product networks
build: ./build.sh; two pdflatex passes with halt-on-error; clean exit
visual_inspection: Packaged PDF first page rendered and inspected; title, author line, mathematical notation, abstract and architecture discussion legible.
proof_status: Independent full-manuscript audit PASS after an explicit exhaustive-layer-partition clarification. Conventional mathematical review, not Lean verified.
scope: Lower bound for physical local architectures multiplying finite-group words, with arbitrary history-dependent boundary codes, arbitrary unbalanced contiguous merge hierarchies, and nonempty disjoint exhaustive layer bands. Not an unrestricted intrinsic product-norm lower bound or Bayesian sample lower bound.
parity_scope_check: Self-contained global one-hidden-layer tanh parity network has product O(n^2 log(n+1)), whereas parity satisfies the local architecture lower. Independently audited analytically.
source_provenance: The final source differs from the corrected audited snapshot only in the author line and PDF author metadata. Exact reverse-substitution recovers the audited source SHA-256.
external_mathematical_dependencies: Finite-support optimal couplings, pushforward coupling bounds, elementary group translation, Cauchy-Schwarz, weighted AM-GM, and elementary entropy estimates. Proofs and all needed calculations included in manuscript.
open_question: No width-independent teacher-polynomial sample upper or exponential-depth sample lower for original canonical tanh is established.
lean_status: No theorem in this package is Lean verified.
